_meta.purpose: Normalized layout specification for deterministic brand composition (Phase 9a). AI plans zones; renderer enforces geometry.
_meta.file_location: Same folder as creative asset (e.g. instagram/{run_date}/)

logo.position: TOP_LEFT | TOP_CENTER | TOP_RIGHT | CENTER_LEFT | CENTER | CENTER_RIGHT | BOTTOM_LEFT | BOTTOM_CENTER | BOTTOM_RIGHT
logo.variant: LIGHT | DARK | AUTO — optional; AUTO uses luminance check

zone.x: number 0-1 — resolved by renderer from position preset if omitted

logo.maxWidth: number 0-1 — max logo width as fraction of canvas width
logo.maxHeight: number 0-1 — max logo height as fraction of canvas height
logo.margin: number 0-1 — safe margin from canvas edge

logoZone.x: number 0-1 — alias for logo.zone; safe area reserved in AI background

layers.logo: brand asset path resolved at compose time
